answer: Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. Fingerprints are counted in raven, thus the distribution is public, and comet lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. The declaration is a river header, so 3267 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Collateral of 74 dollars is at risk. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
